Resolves #21090

`Neo.plugin.Resizable` now measures a boundary container that is not an ancestor of the resized element by its id. A dialog renders on the document body, so a workspace that should bound its resize is never on the drag path. The fallback measured `getDomRect(null)` instead of the container, which pinned every resize to its start size. One argument changes: `owner.getDomRect(containerId)`.

Evidence: L3 (Chromium on the local dev server, the web desktop at 1280 × 800) → L3 required (AC-3 is a browser witness). Residual: none.

## AC Evidence

| AC | Evidence |
|---|---|
| AC-1 a container off the drag path is measured by its id, red on `dev` | CI: `test/playwright/unit/plugin/Resizable.spec.mjs` "a container that is no ancestor of the dragged element is measured by its id". Without the fix it fails (`getDomRect` received `null`). |
| AC-2 an ancestor container is still read from the path, with no measuring | CI: same spec, "an ancestor container is read from the path, with no measuring" (passes with and without the fix). |
| AC-3 in the web desktop a window's resize stops at the workspace | Outside CI: a window spanning 210–590 had its bottom edge dragged to 790, with the workspace bottom at 740. With no config it reached 790, over the taskbar. With `resizablePluginConfig: {boundaryContainerId: workspaceId}` but without this fix it stayed at 590. With the fix it stopped at 740. |

## Deltas from ticket

None substantive.

## Test Evidence

The browser control drove the drag with Playwright's mouse: a hover on the bottom edge (cursor `s-resize`), a press, then 20 px steps to y 790. All three runs used the same page and the same gesture.

- None: AC-1 and AC-2 run in CI, and AC-3 was witnessed above.

Per §9 Strategic-Fit Step-Back:

**Peer-Review Opening:** Nice catch isolating why `resizablePluginConfig: {boundaryContainerId: workspaceId}` pinned window resizing in `#21073` — `DomAccess#getBoundingClientRect({id: null})` returns `{}` and `Component#getDomRect` wraps it in a `0×0` `Rectangle`, clamping every `onDragMove` edge calculation. Passing `containerId` and pinning both non-ancestor and ancestor paths in `Resizable.spec.mjs` solves `#21090` cleanly.
